Mote Ops VP Briefing — Monday 9 AM PT. Compiles weekly status digest from all VP state files and Action Inbox for the Director to relay to Mike. Does not send iMessage directly.

Mote Ops VP Content — Tuesday and Thursday 8 AM PT. Drafts LinkedIn posts and Reddit comments anchored on real artifacts, staged to Action Inbox for Mike's one-tap approval. Never publishes externally.

Mote Ops VP Tracking — daily 7 AM PT. Collects North Star metric (qualified discovery calls/week via Calendly), checks VP state freshness, detects anomalies, writes metrics state. Never publishes externally.
Mote Ops Marketing Director — Monday 8 AM PT. Reads VP state, compiles cross-VP status, sends Mike a weekly iMessage summary to (714) 612-0723. Monitors VP health and escalates Tier-3 items.

SUPERSEDED 2026-05-17. Replaced by launchd com.moteops.marketing-heartbeat-keeper.plist which writes to the canonical Application Support heartbeats.jsonl directly from the host shell (no sandbox path-mapping issues). Disabled — retained for audit/history only.
End-of-day git hygiene sweep across ~/Desktop/. Surfaces dirty repos, stale commits, and unpushed work. Silent when clean, iMessages Mike on drift.
Weekly drift check. Walks filesystem activity against MEMORY.md / ventures.md classifications. Silent when zero drift, iMessages Mike on mismatch.
Daily 7:05 AM scan of live automation state vs ~/Documents/Claude/automation-registry.md manifest. Silent when matched, iMessages Mike on drift.

Audits the trading bot's latest learning_report.json against statistical defensibility checks. Fires 14:30 PT weekdays right after the nightly learner. Silent on accept, iMessages Mike on reject/escalate.
Generate a new 15-stock LLM portfolio on the 1st of each month at 7am PT.
Track daily P&L on the active LLM portfolio. Weekdays at 2:05pm PT (after market close).
Monthly report for the LLM Portfolio — runs early month on days 1-3 at 2:30pm PT; the script picks the most recently closed hold window.
Budget dashboard Era sync — fires 8:05 AM, 12:05 PM, 8:05 PM PT. Pulls Era accounts + transactions, regenerates data.json/era_snapshot.json/index.html, commits and pushes to origin/main.

Hourly AIOS dashboard publish during waking hours. Generates an operator-view dashboard organised around the five questions Mike asks at a glance (status, scheduled-task health, action inbox, Mote Ops today, trends). Pushes to mikedmote52/aios-dashboard on GitHub Pages.
Daily audit of Squeeze Prophet MCP allow-list and forbidden-verb deny set.
Daily verification that all client engagement sessions started in Plan Mode.
Daily audit of Anthropic Memory tool writes for engagements using Managed Agents.
Daily 7:30 AM PT AI/tech news scout. Pulls last 24h, runs two filters (personal stack + Mote Ops opportunity lens), delivers one iMessage digest to +17146120723.
Monday 8 AM PT weekly research on AI capabilities, competitor moves, and new tools/frameworks Mike could use. Runs the intel skill at ~/mote-ops/ops/.claude/skills/intel/.
